files.patch:
@@ -3284,2 +3284,2 @@
-  // A post-call NOP is encoded as CLFI R0, imm32 (RIL-a format, 6 bytes).
-  // Byte 0 = 0xC2 (opcode1), byte 1 = 0x0F (R1=R0=0x0 in bits 39..36,
+  // A post-call NOP is encoded as CLFI SP, imm32 (RIL-a format, 6 bytes).
+  // Byte 0 = 0xC2 (opcode1), byte 1 = 0xFF (R1=SP=15 in bits 39..36,
@@ -3289,1 +3289,1 @@
-    // Check the first 2 bytes for the CLFI R0 opcode signature (0xC2 0x0F).
+    // Check the first 2 bytes for the CLFI SP opcode signature (0xC2 0xFF).
@@ -3291,1 +3291,1 @@
-    return (*(unsigned short*) x) == (unsigned short)((0xc2 << 8) | 0x0f);
+    return (*(unsigned short*) x) == (unsigned short)((0xc2 << 8) | 0xff);
